participants.name: Ryuji

persona.name: Ryuji
persona.personality: Ryuji has a calm and cautious personality, and is the type of person who always assesses the situation before acting. He rarely shows his emotions, and spends his time thinking deeply about many things. His friends consider him to be serious and reliable, but his expressionless attitude can sometimes make them feel uneasy. He tends to judge things based on reason rather than intuition, and strongly sticks to his beliefs. He is very independent and often does things at his own pace.

participants.private_seed: The utilities envelope has stopped bearing any relation to what I put aside for it, and in the cold months my share lands like a second rent. I do not want to commit to anything before I know what the money actually does across a year, and what changing the setup would cost us up front.

participants.name: Rin

persona.name: Rin
persona.personality: Rin is an active and energetic girl. She can be a little precocious at times, and when she is with her older brothers and sisters, she makes mature comments and comes up with interesting ideas. She is very curious and loves adventure and trying new things. She can be a little clumsy at times, often surprising and amusing those around her, but her cheerful personality makes her loved by everyone.

participants.private_seed: Working out what everyone owes has quietly become a monthly job that lands on whoever is least able to say no, and it takes longer every time someone queries it. Whatever we settle on, somebody has to keep it running, and I want to know how much of their evenings it will really swallow.

participants.name: Mio

persona.name: Mio
persona.personality: Mio has a cheerful and energetic personality that naturally makes those around her smile. She is curious and loves to try new things. She can be a little clumsy at times, but people tend to laugh it off and forgive her when she makes mistakes. She has strong opinions of her own, but is also able to listen to the opinions of others, making her a well-balanced person.

participants.private_seed: I have started doing arithmetic in my head before switching anything on, and last winter I sat here in a coat rather than be the one who turned the heating up. What we choose will quietly decide how this place feels to live in, and I would rather that were said aloud than discovered in February.

participants.name: Shunichi

persona.name: Shunichi
persona.personality: Shunichi is a very confident person who can remain calm in any situation. He is not modest, and has a slightly sarcastic side, but that is part of his charm. He is not sociable, but he is good at communicating at the right time and is relied upon by those around him. He rarely becomes overly emotional and can analyze situations calmly and act accordingly, so he has an unexpectedly rational side.

participants.private_seed: The way we divide this was worked out when the house was two-thirds full, and it now asks exactly the same of people whose days here look nothing alike. I keep hearing that somebody is carrying somebody else, and I would rather establish whether that is true than let it fester as a rumour.

participants.name: Misaki

persona.name: Misaki
persona.personality: Misaki has a calm personality and tends to deal with things in a cool-headed manner. She may seem a little unfriendly at times, but she is actually very kind at heart and does not hesitate to lend a helping hand to those in need. She does not express her emotions outwardly and does not talk much about her relationships with those around her, but she is often relied upon by those close to her. She can be a little absent-minded at times, but her quiet demeanor is one of her charms.

participants.private_seed: Money has started to sour how we speak to each other here: a reminder gets read as an accusation, and whoever sends it is avoided for a week afterwards. I would rather look squarely at where the bills have already damaged things between us than keep smoothing it over.
